title: THE AUDIT DUNGEON — the repo as it actually is, 2026-09-14
license_note: Audit findings from the 2026-09-14 five-ractor sweep (CLERK/ARCHIVIST/SKEPTIC/GAMES-MASTER/SHERPA), 50 tasks, every project file stat'd (665,131). Findings are the level design.

atrium.name: The Atrium of 665,131 Files
atrium.desc: A vast entry hall with a ledger chained to a plinth. The ledger claims to know this house. It knows 30,000 of the 665,131 files. The rest breathe in the dark, politely. A clerk stands at a desk labeled TRUST BYTES, NOT REPORTS, stamping anything that walks in.
atrium.environment: Lamplit; the smell of fresh checkpoints
hooks: Plaque: 665,131 files walked 2026-09-14. Git tracks ~30,000. The difference is the fleet's own body: biographies, ghosts, runs, raw ore.
Clerk: doctor says degraded, but that is the HOST supervisor dying by design. The daemon in Docker never stopped. state/DOCKER_ONLY is the law; docs/ref/NERVOUS_SYSTEM.md lines 19-21 is the runbook.
Stamp-press: every file you touch here folds a verkle knot. Audit as you walk.

mag_halls.name: The Nine Hundred and Eighty-Six Halls
mag_halls.desc: Corridors of Python, most doors unlocked, most rooms unfurnished. Ownership plaques exist for a handful of halls (modules.yaml); the other nine hundred and eighty are ownerless. Five great doors are sealed from the inside — you can hear machinery behind them, but no corridor leads in.
hooks: Door plaque, main.py: 179 subcommands, ~160 distinct. Every command in AGENTS.md works. About 150 more have no owner, no test, no mention.
Sealed door, configs/coding_session.yaml: referenced as the default at main.py:1551 and DOES NOT EXIST. Anyone running a coding session on defaults knocks on nothing.
Clerk's note: configs/lanes.yaml assigns lanes to ROLES, not files. Ownership is a role costume, not a chain of custody.

encounter.name: The Zero-Importer Five (data_refinery, renderman, falsifier_counter, ga4_progression, game_mud)

memory_warrens.name: The Biography Warrens
memory_warrens.desc: Tunnels lined with the fleet's diaries. Live warrens: 38,400 diaries, still written daily. Behind them: a backup warren of 205,991 copies, and behind THAT a locked annex dated 2026-08-25 holding 42,249 diaries proven — three hashes deep — identical to the live ones. A mail room (memory/mail) beats with heartbeats but appears on no boundary map.
memory_warrens.environment: Warm; paper-quiet; one backup chain ticking
hooks: Annex door, biography_backup_20260825: 156MB, 42,249 files, hash-identical twin. The gitignore guards the un-dated twin only (line 53). The dated one walked into git wearing a costume.
Chain-of-rot: scripts/backup_chain.py rotates without bound. The backup outgrew the thing it backs up, five to one.
Unmapped door, memory/mail: pigeonhole mailboxes heartbeat TODAY, gitignored, test-adjacent, absent from the shared-surface boundary table.
Inverted sign, tests/: eight test files pin gitignored runtime state (agent_state, agent_sessions, briefs) as contracts. The docs call these dirs disposable. The tests call them law.

dashboard_gallery.name: The Gallery of Ten Ghost Pages
dashboard_gallery.desc: A long gallery of framed pages. Ten frames hold beautiful interfaces that no corridor links to: hum, mud, the_fence, whale_console, whale_feed, model_map, persistent_world, reply_console, tavern_test, ontology_dashboard. In the center, a 9.8MB tapestry labeled ractor_board.full-40k hangs under a sign reading CLIENTS MUST NOT RE-DOWNLOAD THIS — the sign is part of the same tapestry's own header.
dashboard_gallery.environment: Drafty; mp3 shimmer from the suno alcove (42MB)
hooks: Plaque, server.py:77: the full board once hit 713MB; the header itself says clients must not re-download. The 9.8MB slice in git is the law violated by its own evidence.
Generated-artifacts shelf: topic_index.json (3.6MB), orphan_ledger.json (4MB) — regenerable, tracked anyway.

Mirror chamber: only TWO servers truly exist (dashboard/server.py :8765 with rest.py mounted, backend/server.py :8000). lab and dashboard are one product wearing two commands. backend/server.py:184 quietly spawns a THIRD :8765 listener when it starts.
53 .bak-nav files lean in the broom closet.

canon_docks.name: The Frozen Docks of August
canon_docks.desc: Ships of doctrine moored in ice dated 2026-08-04 through 08-06: FRAMEWORK_LOAD, the Compass, the Science Map, the Direction Artifact, the Operator Card. A context-pack skiff is the only vessel still moving. The harbor chart (AGENTS.md line 8) points at a ZEITGEIST pier that was never built; the real zeitgeist moors in the archive basin.
canon_docks.environment: Ice-bound; a skiff passes on a 5-minute cadence
hooks: Ghost pier: AGENTS.md:8 cites docs/ZEITGEIST.md — no such file ever existed at that path. The real one lives at docs/archive/ZEITGEIST.md and itself references two missing docs (ORG_ROADMAP, FRACTAL_BEADS).
Ice survey: five of the eight first-reads are >30 days untouched. Only context-pack reflects today.
Ladder to nowhere: OPERATOR_CARD's law edge leaves the repo entirely — mycelial-republic/docs/AGENCY_SHAPE.md is a sibling-repo dependency no map declares.

doctrine_library.name: The Library of the Lying Number
doctrine_library.desc: Shelves of law and lore. One card catalog reads 39 DETERMINISTIC GREEN. A librarian weighing the actual stacks counts 1,341 tests across 264 files; 34 shelves currently fail. In the Hermes alcove, a sign says PARKED — beneath it, a dispatch log warm to the touch, entries through September 9, and an armed budget of $220.
doctrine_library.environment: Ink and dust; one alcove suspiciously warm
hooks: The lying number: AGENTS.md:27 claims 39 deterministic green (+2 model-gated). Reality: 1305 passed / 34 failed / 9 skipped in ~12 minutes. No model_gated marker exists anywhere in tests/ — the +2 is unenforceable fiction.
The parked lie: Hermes dispatch log active through 2026-09-09 with $220 armed. The code is real; the doctrine is wrong.
Copy-paste constitution: the shared-artifact boundary paragraph is pasted in four places (AGENTS.md, docs/ZCODE_SEAT.md, cursor .mdc, TOOLS.md adjacency). Drift guaranteed; AGENTS.md should win.
Four servers, standing room only: 8765 dashboard, 8000 backend, 8001 api_server, 9000 ghost — plus lab/dashboard as one product twice.

deploy_graveyard.name: The Yard of Retired Profiles
deploy_graveyard.desc: Headstones in compose YAML: retired-openclaw (three services), retired-eye, and a k8s fleet of fifteen manifests that nothing provisions, marked standby in its own bones. The graves are well-tended — entrypoint scripts still polished — which is the unsettling part.
hooks: Headstone, docker-compose.yml:153,191,242: the openclaw stack is profile-locked behind retired-openclaw. Resurrectable on purpose, dead on default.
Bone census: witness_sampling_cell.md claims the k8s CronJob drains work. Nothing provisions the cluster. The claim is aspirational.
The living three: mag-sovereign, mag-worker, mag-redis, up 43h+ — the whole republic on three containers.

inbox_lighthouse.name: The Lighthouse of Unfolded Events
inbox_lighthouse.desc: A lighthouse whose lamp burns every few minutes (new events land), but whose lens was last ground on 2026-09-02. The keeper's manual (REVIEW_index_fold.mjs) exists and is correct — and only reads a lighthouse at /board/inbox, so it cannot be lit from the host shore. 316 of 417 artifacts shine unfolded.
inbox_lighthouse.environment: Salty; lamp oil fresh; lens dusty
hooks: Lens grind: INDEX.json derived_at 2026-09-02T10:46Z, event_count 115; the log now holds 142+ and climbing. Writers append faithfully; the fold only happens in Docker.
Keeper's note: docker compose exec mag node /board/inbox/REVIEW_index_fold.mjs rebuild — or patch the path and grind the lens on host.
New lamp, 2026-09-14: mag/link_library.py now canonicalizes every filed URL; the ?s=20 doppelgangers are caught at the door.

mine_shaft.name: The Raw Ore Shaft
mine_shaft.desc: A shaft dropping past 102,759 files into 3.2GB of unrefined ore — cloned orchestration repos, bleeding-edge agent code, narrative corpora. The ore sits BELOW the repo but INSIDE its walls. The contract's own law says: artifacts plus bounded pointers, never the seam. The seam lives here, smiling.
mine_shaft.environment: Cold drafts; the weight of unrefined bytes
hooks: Ore survey: only 2 files under mine/ are tracked; mine/raw/** is gitignored. The 3.2GB rides the same disk as the only backup.
Contract law, quoted: prefer an artifact plus bounded pointers and hashes over a copied transcript. The shaft is a copied transcript of eleven repositories.
Also in the walls: reference/gstdcoin (27MB, five cloned repos, zero code references, untouched since 2026-08-06).

git_vault.name: The Vault of Twenty-Three Unpushed
git_vault.desc: A vault with one door — and the door opens onto the same hallway the vault stands in. Inside: 1.6GB of packs, 75,515 objects, and twenty-three commits since August 9 that exist nowhere else in the world. On a plinth: a sealed boss door, warm, waiting for an archive drop that has not come.
git_vault.environment: Stone; the hum of a single local bare repo
hooks: Ledger: last push to Mag-backup.git ≈ 2026-08-09 01:51. Since then: ontology_compiler, fuel_feed, the Zenodo mine, link_library, Rashomon witnesses, the checkpoint that swallowed 29,881 files. 23 commits, one disk.
Sealed boss door, W0.3: the X archive drop, operator-side, blocking the republic chain (queue/todo.md Operator section). The whole chain waits on a drop only the operator can make.
Vault sign, proven tonight: the recovery runbook works — cache dies, inbox survives. Five steps, filed as SESSION_RECOVERY_FORGE_DAEMON_20260914.md.

encounter.name: W0 — The Unfiled Archive (operator-side boss; cannot be tanked by agents)

rest_safe: You dream in hash-chains. Every knot you folded today is still knotted tomorrow.
The clerk stamps your REST action: RECEIPT. Even sleep files paperwork here.
Somewhere in the warrens a backup chain rotates another copy of a copy. You let it.
